business.what: India's largest listed pathology chain by revenue: blood, urine and tissue tests (routine, wellness bundles and specialised tests such as genomics, oncology, autoimmune and reproductive), plus a small radiology business (<5% of revenue). Founded 1949 by Major S.K. Lal; listed Dec-2015.
business.network: Hub-and-spoke: 312 clinical labs at Mar-26 (National Reference Lab in Delhi; regional reference labs in Kolkata, Bengaluru and Mumbai; satellite labs), 7,727 patient service centres (PSCs, mostly franchised collection centres) and 13,935 pick-up points (PUPs: doctors, nursing homes and small labs that hand over samples). Samples travel from PSCs/PUPs to a satellite lab for routine tests and to a reference lab for complex ones. 53 NABL- and 2 CAP-accredited labs. Over 4,800 pathology and radiology tests and panels.
business.mix: B2C (walk-in and home-collection patients, ~75% of revenue) vs B2B (hospitals, institutions, other labs, ~25%): 'B2C contribution for us has been in the range of 75%' (Q1FY27 call); 'about 75%' in FY26 (Q4FY26 call).
business.kpis: FY26: 30.3 mn patients (+5.3%), 94.5 mn samples (+10.4%), revenue per patient ₹912 (FY25 ₹855), tests per patient 3.1 (AR FY26 MD&A; Q4FY26 PPT).
business.swasthfit: SwasthFit bundled preventive health packages (launched after the 2015 IPO): 22% of revenue in FY24, 24% in FY25, 27% in FY26, 27% in Q1FY27 (growing ~20% a year); Suburban's packages are included. Not margin dilutive (Q3FY26 call).
business.rural: GraminFit rural preventive programme in 7 states (UP, Bihar, MP, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, Odisha, West Bengal); >1.1 lakh patients tested in Q1FY27 (Q1FY27 PPT and call).
business.sovaaka: Sovaaka premium AI-led preventive-health centre (one centre, opened Jan-2026); no further centres planned in FY27 (Q4FY26 call).
business.international: Nepal and Bangladesh (71.83% subsidiary); Dubai holding company (FZCO) incorporated FY26; 80% of Sunshine Healthcare, Ghana (board approval 24-Jul-2026, consideration up to GHS 45.6 mn, ~₹38 cr); Uzbekistan subsidiary incorporated 19-Aug-2026; international <5% of revenue and not expected to change much for 3-5 years (Q1FY27 call).
business.src: AR FY26 MD&A pp.125-128; Q1FY27 and Q4FY26 PPTs and calls

regions.note: Regional mix stable for three years; North + East ~77% (AR FY26 MD&A p.123). Delhi NCR (the highest-realisation market) grows 'double digit, as near to the overall revenue as possible' (Q1FY27 call). West (Mumbai/Suburban) slipped from 15% to 14% in FY26. Pricing is set by cluster, so a Tier-3 town near Lucknow is priced like Lucknow (Q4FY26 call).

suburban.deal: Agreed 26-Oct-2021, consolidated from 12-Nov-2021: 100% of Suburban Diagnostics (India) Pvt Ltd, Mumbai, for an enterprise value of ₹925 cr (18.5x FY22 EBITDA, floor ₹925 cr, cap ₹1,150 cr), all cash; Suburban had FY21 revenue of ₹294 cr and EBITDA of ₹57.5 cr (incl. COVID testing). Funded partly with a term loan (₹345 cr borrowed in FY22, fully repaid by FY25).
suburban.since: Weak for most of FY24-FY26: an IT/LIMS integration and the move of its collection network to franchisees cost revenue for ~3 quarters; West's share of revenue fell from 15% (FY24-25) to 14% (FY26). Voluntarily liquidated into the parent on 18-Mar-2025 (one-time deferred-tax credit ₹40.8 cr in Q4FY25). Q4FY26: 'started picking up'; Q1FY27: 'really turning around ... very close double digits' growth; new stores and radiology centres being opened under the Suburban brand. Profitability no longer reported separately (back end merged); the West's margin is below Delhi NCR's with room to improve (Q4FY26 call).
suburban.intangibles: Acquisition intangibles in the consolidated books (Mar-26 carrying value): goodwill ₹548 cr; brand ₹22.1 cr (amortised ₹39.2 cr a year, fully written off in FY27); customer relationships ₹138.4 cr (₹16.2 cr a year); trademarks ₹12.0 cr (₹1.65 cr a year); non-compete ₹0.7 cr. Amortisation of other intangibles was ₹64.8 cr in FY26 (incl. ₹7.0 cr software).
suburban.src: Business Today (27-Oct-2021); indianpharmapost; AR FY26 notes 5, 31, 33, 41; Q4FY25 PPT; Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 calls

notes: Highest quarterly growth in four years; volume-led (patients +8.2%, samples +10.7%).

Revenue per patient ₹968 (+10%): CGHS/ECHS rate revision worth 2-3% of company revenue, expected to continue 'at least another 2-3 quarters'; rest from test and geography mix (Delhi NCR, specialised tests).

Margin 31.0% (+232bp): operating leverage (employee costs +7%); part of the CGHS pass-through 'for maybe one or two quarters more'. Management keeps the 27-28% margin guide and will reinvest any excess.
Revenue guidance: 'more towards mid-teens rather than early teens' (from early-to-mid teens, 13-15%); a formal update after H1.
No price increase in H1; to be reassessed after H1. Competitive pricing 'neither ... too favorable'.
Labs: 12-15 to be added in FY27; 3-4 radiology centres; capex ~₹140-150 cr.
Board approved 80% of Sunshine Healthcare, Ghana (≤GHS 45.6 mn) and 30% of Neuome Technologies (≤₹3.5 cr); interim dividend ₹5.

epsBeforeExceptional.note: Profit to owners less the FY25 tax credit (₹487.14 − 40.80 cr) / 16.659 cr weighted shares; plus the FY26 labour-code charge after tax (₹504.78 + 22.52 cr) / 16.691 cr. Bonus-adjusted. Company normalised PAT ₹451 cr (FY25) and ₹532 cr (FY26) before minorities.

history.event: Founded by Major (Dr) S.K. Lal in Delhi.
National Reference Lab set up in Delhi.
IPO and listing; SwasthFit bundles launched afterwards.
COVID testing: RT-PCR revenue ₹242 cr in FY22 (12% of revenue), ₹25 cr in FY23, ₹3 cr in FY24 (Q4FY24 PPT).
Suburban Diagnostics (Mumbai) acquired for EV ₹925 cr.
Mumbai Regional Reference Lab commissioned; Bengaluru reference lab earlier.
Suburban voluntarily liquidated into the parent: ₹40.8 cr one-time deferred-tax credit (FY25).
Om Prakash Manchanda steps down as Managing Director; Shankha Banerjee (CEO) leads the business.
1:1 bonus issue (record date 19-Dec-2025): 8.38 cr shares allotted; share count 16.76 cr.
GST on reagents cut from 12% to 5%; benefit passed on to patients through price cuts. ₹30.1 cr labour-code charge.
Sovaaka premium preventive-health centre opened (Delhi NCR).
CARE upgrades the issuer rating to AA+/Stable.
Shahbazkers Diagnostic Centre, Mumbai (one lab, FY26 revenue ₹6.1 cr) bought for up to ₹20 cr.
Q1FY27: revenue +19.1%; Ghana (80% of Sunshine Healthcare) and Neuome (30%) approved.
Board approves 70% of SN Genelab (Gujarat genomics; FY26 revenue ₹57.96 cr) for up to ₹168 cr; completion expected by 30-Nov-2026.

fy27: Revenue growth 'early to mid-teens' (13-15%) at Q4FY26 (30-Apr-2026); 'more towards mid-teens rather than early teens' after Q1 (24-Jul-2026).
Patient volume growth 6-7% (start of year); Q1 came in at 8.2%.
EBITDA margin 27-28% (reported basis; FY26 27.2% incl. the labour-code charge, 28.3% before it): any excess to be reinvested in labs, radiology, precision diagnostics and international.
12-15 new labs; 3-4 radiology centres (Delhi NCR plus a Tier-2 pilot); one Sovaaka centre only.
Capex ₹100-120 cr (Q4FY26 call) and ~₹140-150 cr (Q1FY27 call), plus M&A from the ~₹1,700 cr cash pile (West/South platforms).
Price increase: none in H1FY27; to be reviewed after H1.
